parent_objective: implement bounded high-speed/late history-source repair with matched-current hidden-divergent donor screen
blocked_by: M1578 design has not yet been implemented
supersedes: generic M1576 source generation for high-speed/late

public_gates: M1579 must implement the M1578 bounded high-speed/late source repair
M1579 must use matched-current hidden-divergent donor screen
M1579 must use history-sensitive acceptance and current-frame controls
M1579 must write high-speed/late source, pair, intervention, and summary artifacts
M1579 must keep materialization training PPO promotion and private holdout blocked

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: implements the one allowed high-speed/late history-source repair after M1576 nulls
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: public bounded implementation only; no candidate materialization, training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, corpus export, paper-level or level3 self-identification claim
stop_condition: stop after one bounded implementation smoke and route to audit
stop if implementation changes actor inputs or writes training corpus
stop if implementation omits matched-current hidden-divergent donor screen
stop if implementation omits current-frame controls
fallback_plan: route to result audit whether gates pass or fail
route to branch synthesis after audit if high-speed/late remain null
keep M1576/M1579 as public diagnostics until audited
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M1578 admits exactly one bounded implementation with mandatory audit

admission_evidence: M1578 pre-registers source modes, donor screen, interventions, artifacts, gates, and synthesis fallback
allowed_updates: high-speed/late source repair module and focused tests
M1579 status queue scoreboard research log and review

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1579 explicitly tests current-frame substitution via donor response/action stream, reset hidden, zero-current, zero-action-history, and zero-all controls.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If high-speed/late remain null, route to audit and branch synthesis rather than more narrow repair.
allowed_claims: at most level2 history-encoded reactive evidence if high-speed/late history surgery causes outcome degradation and controls do not dominate
no promotion, training corpus export, PPO, private-holdout, paper-level result or level3 self-identification claim

hypothesis: Matched-current hidden-divergent high-speed/late source repair can find anchors where wrong-history interventions affect closed-loop outcome.
success_criteria: focused tests cover source modes, donor screen, and summary gates
candidate materialization training PPO promotion private holdout actor-input changes and training-corpus export remain blocked
failure_criteria: implementation changes actor inputs or uses private holdout
implementation exports a training corpus or starts training/PPO
decision_rule: M1579 passes as implementation if it runs bounded public high-speed/late repair with clean guardrails and writes required metrics; it must still route to audit before materialization.
